address: 4/100 Tory Street, Te Aro, Wellington, 6011, New Zealand
bio: The Syrian owner-chef follows heirloom recipes passed down in his family to craft authentic, home-style Middle Eastern dishes. The natural flavours of vegetables and meat are accentuated by herbs, spices, lemon juice and yoghurt. The dips with pita bread stand out in particular. Try hummus perfumed with red pepper, garlic, rosemary and pine nuts; or makdoos labneh, which are stuffed, oil-preserved baby aubergines in homemade strained yoghurt.
